existing.description: The Radboud Scholarship Programme is a very selective scholarship for talented, highly motivated non-EEA students with outstanding study results applying to a complete English-taught Radboud University master's programme. A Radboud Scholarship reduces the tuition fee to EUR 2,771 for 2027/2028, against an example normal fee of about EUR 19,000, and covers visa, residence permit, health insurance and liability insurance costs, while living and studying costs remain the student's responsibility. A maximum of 26 scholarships are available for 2027/2028 across six faculties, the application is made through the OSIRIS master's application with two reference letters and a CV, the OSIRIS submission deadline is 31 January 2027 and the file must be complete by 14 February 2027, and the decision is communicated before mid-April 2027.
eligibility: Not be eligible for the lower EU/EEA tuition fee for other reasons

Have (or be about to obtain) a bachelor's degree achieved outside the Netherlands, with no Dutch degrees and no previous education in the Netherlands (exchange programmes excluded unless part of that bachelor's)
Meet the English language proficiency requirement of the chosen master's programme
Be fully admitted to the English-taught master's programme starting 1 September 2027, as stated in the formal admission letter
Be able to comply with the conditions for obtaining a visa for the Netherlands
Be enrolled at Radboud University as a full-time student for the academic year and programme concerned
existing.eligibility_summary: Non-EU/EEA passport holders with a bachelor's degree obtained outside the Netherlands, admitted to an eligible English-taught Radboud master's programme starting 1 September 2027, who meet the programme's English requirement and can obtain a Dutch visa.
benefits: Tuition fee reduced to EUR 2,771 for 2027/2028
Visa, residence permit and insurance costs covered
Possible renewal for a second year of a two-year master's programme if all first-year courses are passed
Can be combined with the NL Scholarship
coverage: Reduction of the tuition fee to EUR 2,771 (amount to be confirmed) for 2027/2028, against an example normal fee of about EUR 19,000
Visa, residence permit, health insurance (Aon Student Insurance) and liability insurance costs for the stay in the Netherlands
No coverage of living and studying costs
requirements: Indicate in the OSIRIS master's application that you wish to apply for a Radboud Scholarship
Upload two reference letters and a curriculum vitae as part of the scholarship request
Submit in OSIRIS by 31 January 2027 23:59 CET
Ensure the application is complete by 14 February 2027 23:59 CET
documents: Two reference letters (preferably academic), following Radboud's reference letter guidelines
Complete OSIRIS application for the master's programme with the scholarship option selected
existing.english_requirement: Must meet the English language proficiency requirement of the chosen master's programme; proof of English proficiency should be handed in before the 14 February 2027 completeness deadline.
application_method: Apply for admission to an eligible English-taught master's programme in the OSIRIS Application system
Indicate in that application that you wish to apply for a Radboud Scholarship
Upload two reference letters and a curriculum vitae
Submit by the OSIRIS deadline and complete the file by the second deadline
existing.selection_notes: The university states the programme is "a very selective scholarship programme" and that selection is by the selection committee of the faculty applied to, based on academic excellence, ambition and references; some study programmes also hold interviews.
existing.best_fit: Non-EU/EEA applicants with outstanding study results, strong references and a clear motivation who are admitted to an eligible English-taught Radboud master's programme for September 2027 and can cover their own living costs.
existing.notes: The scholarship is funded from Radboud University's Profiling Fund and its requirements follow that fund's regulations. Selection and admission to the master's programme are two separate processes. Erasmus Mundus and joint-degree master's programmes are excluded.
existing.application_period: One round per academic year for the September 2027 intake: submit in OSIRIS by 31 January 2027 23:59 CET, complete by 14 February 2027 23:59 CET, decision before mid-April 2027.
existing.deadline_display: "You must have submitted your application in the online OSIRIS Application system on 31 January 2027 23:59 CET at the latest." and "your application needs to be complete by 14 February 2027 23:59 CET at the latest."
existing.program_type: University tuition-fee scholarship from Radboud's Profiling Fund
